raw_content:
```yaml
---
id: vuln-tabby-1c077147
languages:
  - typescript
pattern: |
  (func.name=authHandler and func.args.length=3 and func.args[2].type=Function) and
    (
      (func.args[0].value in ["publickey", "password"] and func.args[1].value=false) or
      (func.args[0].value="none" and func.args[1].value=true)
    ) and
    (
      (func.args[2].calls.length>0 and func.args[2].calls[0].name=handleAuth) or
      (func.args[2].calls.length>1 and func.args[2].calls[1].name=handleAuth)
    )
message: |
  Potential vulnerability in SSH authentication handler
severity: WARNING
metadata:
  description: >
    The `authHandler` function in the `SSHSession` class calls the `handleAuth`
    function without waiting for a promise returned by `hostVerifiedPromise`. This
    could allow an attacker to bypass certificate validation and gain unauthorized
    access to the system.
  affected_functions:
    - SSHSession::authHandler
  affected_variables:
    - hostVerifiedPromise
```
